actions.reason: K8_C0001 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (oxidative-phosphorylation/fatty-acid-metabolism down-regulation), but its exact-set membership is not positively represented: CT, RNA, and WSI geometries are non-separating with only WXS favorable, giving a non-positive membership-role conclusion. The two nominated pair reviews (with K8_C0004 and K8_C0006) were completed at both boundary and structure stages; the K8_C0001|K8_C0004 union retains a two-cluster structure and the K8_C0001|K8_C0006 union is single-cluster dominated with a high normalized-cut cost, so neither pair provides positive evidence that removing a boundary yields a more defensible representation. With membership unsupported and no structural alternative supported, retention is not justified.

No pair provides positive evidence that removing a boundary yields a more defensible representation, so retention remains unsupported.
